organic.snippet: A single stage single-use chromatographic clarification solution designed as an efficient option for harvesting and clarification of modern cell cultures.

peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is a chromatographic clarifier?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: 3M™ Harvest RC Chromatographic Clarifier utilizes advanced Q functionalized fibrous chromatography media to achieve single-stage clarification, enabling predictable and consistent cell loading capacity for CHO cell culture fluid for a wide range of packed cell volumes.
